name: umbra
description: Local-first AI studio (GUI and TUI) for running and inspecting language models on your own hardware. Being built against an NVIDIA DGX Spark. Early development — not usable yet.

name: gate
description: Pre-commit hook that scans staged changes for credentials and can redact what it finds. Pattern-based, so expect false positives and misses.

name: vexes
description: Dependency scanner for several ecosystems. Flags install scripts, unexpected network or filesystem access, and names close to popular packages. Heuristics, not verdicts.

name: mcp-librarian
description: MCP server giving coding agents a local skill library — BM25 search, Ed25519 signing, integrity checks on load.
